sloka: आग्राहि महावीर्यं तदिदं नात्र संशयः ।स तां बुद्ध्वार्थतत्त्वेन सिंहिकां मतिमान्कपिः ।व्यवर्धत महाकायः प्रवृषीव वलाहकः ॥५-१-१८८॥
transliteration: āgrāhi mahāvīryaṁ tadidaṁ nātra saṁśayaḥ ।sa tāṁ buddhvārthatattvena siṁhikāṁ matimānkapiḥ ।vyavardhata mahākāyaḥ pravṛṣīva valāhakaḥ ॥5-1-188॥

translations.english: Recognising the true nature of Simhika the clutcher of shadows, the wise Hanuman grew to a huge size like a cloud in rainy season.
